assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: final website comparison-slider image, STUDIO STUDY, single square 1:1 photograph.
Primary request: create one original fictional unbranded premium wristwatch with a deep blue dial, polished metallic case and a refined steel bracelet with narrow champagne-gold center accents. It should suggest the broad category of a blue-and-gold dive watch while having its own restrained original geometry and no recognizable branded design.
Scene: clean very pale cool-grey limestone tabletop with faint stone texture, seamless soft neutral background, sophisticated high-end studio product photography.
Watch design: softly faceted cushion-round brushed stainless steel case, fine polished champagne-gold edge, slim midnight-blue timing bezel with fine gold hash marks and no numerals, perfectly plain deep navy sunburst dial with twelve slim gold baton hour markers, two slender gold faceted hands and fine straight seconds hand, no date window, no round hour plots, no triangle at 12, no crown emblem, no lettering. Time is 10:10. Small understated crown at 3 o'clock. Premium broad multi-link steel bracelet with subtle narrow gold center inlays, curved behind the case naturally, precise believable metal craftsmanship and sapphire crystal.
Composition: square canvas. Centered complete watch in the middle, face gently tilted toward camera in a three-quarter product view. Watch 12 o'clock axis points up and slightly toward upper left, 6 o'clock toward lower right. Case center at x50% y48%, outer case diameter about 43% of image width, with upper bracelet curling behind toward upper-left and lower bracelet running toward lower-right. Entire bracelet comfortably within frame, product silhouette occupies central 72% of frame width and 78% of frame height, generous clean margin. Camera fixed at elevated 45 degrees, 85mm macro product lens, face and bracelet sharp.
Lighting: soft wide neutral diffused key from upper left, fine white edge reflections, mild realistic contact shadow, luxurious restrained polish, deep legible blue face. No dramatic color cast.
Constraints: one single watch and one single full-frame photo only. No collage, split screen, inset, border, box, text, logo, brand, watermark, signature, people, hands, extra props. No real manufacturer's distinctive hands, crown, indices, logo, model name or exact recognizable case/bracelet design. Do not put any text or brand on dial or clasp. It must look like an original coherent fictional product rather than an existing watch. This same camera, framing, watch and pose will later be used for a second treatment.

Use case: lighting-weather / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: final square website comparison-slider image, CREATIVE TREATMENT.
Input image: the exact edit target and sole product-identity master.
Primary request: transform ONLY the environment and lighting of this same original fictional unbranded blue-and-gold watch into an exquisite cinematic luxury advertisement. Replace the pale limestone tabletop/background with a dark wet charcoal basalt rock slab that completely fills the frame, fine realistic water droplets and a subtle wet sheen across the surrounding stone, deep rich shadows. Use a controlled cool-blue edge light and one warm narrow softbox reflection across the metallic case and gold bracelet accents; deep midnight-blue dial stays clear and legible. Photoreal luxury product photography, elegant and restrained, no glowing fantasy effects.
STRICT COMPARISON ALIGNMENT: preserve EXACT square canvas, camera, framing, lens, case scale and center, every watch contour, bracelet-link positions, crop, pose, orientation and contact point from the input. The case, crown, dial, hands at 10:10, twelve slim gold baton markers, blue bezel with gold hash marks, narrow champagne-gold bracelet inlays, sapphire crystal and complete silhouette must occupy exactly the same pixels and dimensions as the input except for plausible changed reflections. Do not zoom, move, rotate or redesign the product. Keep the complete bracelet in frame. Retain empty no-text dial. This is the same watch in the same pose in a different atmosphere, for a reveal slider. Stone can be textured and uneven around the watch but must not obscure any product part.
Constraints: ONE full-frame square photograph. No inset, diptych, collage, border, presentation box, other props, text, logo, branding, watermark, signature or real manufacturer's identifiable symbols. Original fictional unbranded product. Preserve product identity faithfully. Dramatic wet stone rather than a pool of water.
